description: React state updates from effect cleanups (docs/design/REACTIVITY-ALIASING.md, cross-framework matrix): at unmount a passive cleanup updates the parent and its own unmounted state (nothing renders), a layout cleanup updates the parent while React commits (rendered with the passive cleanups' updates, after them), a cleanup reads a ref's current value; a cleanup run because a dependency changed updates the parent too (React 19.3.0 in Chromium; the native model agreed before, a regression case)
